decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE capturing the conditional 5V supply and GPIO3 switching relevant to the SK6812 LEDs; the boost rail's total current rating and other loads do not require further candidate changes.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the standalone USB-powered 3.3V behavior; the switched 5V boost-load update does not change that requirement.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the two 3.3V sources and Schottky OR-ing behavior; the 5V boost current and load mapping do not alter that behavior.
The source does not change how battery-charge status is indicated or the CHGLED connector circuitry; SK6812 power behavior is independently represented by the LED power requirement.
The source discusses the main-board USB-C standalone-power path and does not change the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The operating-mode power map does not alter the candidate's VMID-to-VSYS topology or reference-design conformance requirements.
Stating that the battery feeds the AXP2101 does not resolve or change the battery connector's pinout, placement, connector family, or mounting style.
The source provides a power-distribution map but does not change any overcharge, overdischarge, thermal, or other battery-protection rule.
The source does not change the battery NTC connection or temperature-monitoring behavior.
The power mapping has no effect on the power board's eight-layer stack requirement.
The source changes electrical power mapping only and does not alter board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure fit.
The source does not change the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
